In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], the [[Kiffu Guardians]] maintained a '''security compound''' on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]. It was attacked by rogue [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] under the control of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]], and all within were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The mysterious death of the compound's Guardian personnel led [[Sheyf]] [[Tinté Vos]] to request [[Mission to Kiffex|aid]] from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] in investigating the source of the attack.
